description: Guest houses and B&Bs (tourism=guest_house) in the Netherlands derived from OpenStreetMap POI exports (EU-POIS/NL, quadkey zoom-12 tiles). Named features only, filtered to the European-NL bounding box (lat 50.7-53.62, lon 3.3-7.25) to exclude cross-border tile bleed, deduplicated on (name, ~100 m coordinates), WGS84 coordinates to 6 dp, sorted by name. Native Dutch names preserved. (c) OpenStreetMap contributors.
